title: Naomi's Loss and Ruth's Vow
summary: Famine drives Elimelech's family to Moab, where he and his two sons die; when Naomi decides to return to Bethlehem, her daughter-in-law Ruth vows to stay with her and worship her God.

title: Ruth Gleans in Boaz's Field
summary: Ruth gleans leftover grain to provide for Naomi and happens into the field of Boaz, a worthy relative of Naomi's dead husband, who shows her unusual kindness and provision.
blurb: Boaz shows Ruth kindness while gleaning

title: Ruth's Request at the Threshing Floor
summary: At Naomi's instruction, Ruth approaches Boaz by night at the threshing floor and asks him, as a family redeemer, to take her under his protection; he agrees but names a nearer redeemer first.
blurb: Ruth asks Boaz to redeem her

title: Boaz Redeems Ruth and Marries Her
summary: At the town gate, Boaz secures the right of redemption from a nearer relative and marries Ruth; their son Obed becomes the grandfather of David, closing the book with a genealogy.
blurb: Boaz redeems Ruth; Obed's line to David
